usage: This idiom describes a situation where conditions are right, making success or a certain result inevitable.
It is often used to express that efforts will lead to outcomes smoothly without extra force or interference.
You can use it to encourage patience, implying that good things come when the time is right.
The phrase highlights the natural flow or development in a process or relationship.
It can also emphasize the inevitability of progress once all necessary elements are in place.

examples.sentence: 只要你勤力學習，水到渠成，考試一定會取得好成績。
examples.jyutping: zi2 jiu3 nei5 kan4 lik6 hok6 zaap6, seoi2 dou3 keoi4 sing4, haau2 si3 jat1 ding6 wui5 ceot1 dak1 hou2 sing4 zik1.
examples.meaning: As long as you study hard, success will come naturally and you will definitely get good exam results.

examples.sentence: 呢個計劃已經準備得好充足，水到渠成就係時間問題。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ji5 ging1 zeon2 bei6 dak1 hou2 cung1 zuk1, seoi2 dou3 keoi4 sing4 zau6 hai6 si4 gaan3 man6 tai4.
examples.meaning: This plan is well-prepared, so the natural outcome is just a matter of time.

examples.sentence: 唔使擔心，努力工作，水到渠成嘅時候自然會有收穫。
examples.jyutping: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, nou5 lik6 gung1 zok3, seoi2 dou3 keoi4 sing4 ge3 si4 hau6 zi6 jin4 wui5 jau5 sau1 wok6.
examples.meaning: Don’t worry, work hard and when the time comes, there will naturally be rewards.

examples.sentence: 佢哋嘅合作好融洽，水到渠成自然開展咗新項目。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hap6 zok3 hou2 jung4 hap6, seoi2 dou3 keoi4 sing4 zi6 jin4 hoi1 zin2 zo2 san1 hong6 muk6.
examples.meaning: Their cooperation is harmonious and naturally led to the launch of a new project.
